units.source_text: 据说当年石川五右卫门①脚踏楼上的栏杆，赞赏满目的鲜花，大概就是在这山门吧。

en.t: They say that long ago Ishikawa Goemon set his foot on the railing upstairs and admired the flowers filling his view; it must have been at this mountain gate.

units.source_text: 尽管已是叶樱的季节，我们还是抱着一种孩子般的心倩摆起五右卫n一样的姿势，眺望一番这般景色。

en.t: Although it was already the season of leafy cherry trees, we struck Goemon-like poses with a childlike feeling and gazed for a while at the scene.

units.source_text: 我们购了不贵的门票，就登上水色完全发黑了的很陡的阶梯。

en.t: We bought inexpensive admission tickets and climbed a very steep staircase whose pale blue paint had completely darkened.

units.source_text: 登到尽头的休息台时，鹤川的头碰撞在低矮的天花板上。

en.t: When we reached the landing at the top, Tsurukawa hit his head on the low ceiling.

units.source_text: 我刚要取笑他，自己却马上也碰撞上了。

en.t: Just as I was about to laugh at him, I immediately hit my own head too.

units.source_text: 两人拐了个弯，登上台阶就来到了楼上。

en.t: The two of us turned a corner, climbed the steps, and came out upstairs.
